upstream: A2 fixed-slot fail-closed transaction semantics qualified
B2B infiltration-front coordinate sort relaxation mass qualified
B2C-R2 grouped delta-K Eq18 numerical representation qualified and precision tuning stopped

scope.state: front depth z in cm for one theta-bin increment
scope.independent_reference: analytic integral of dz/dt=A/z+B with deterministic bisection inversion

cases.horizon_policy: T=min(0.01 day, 0.1*z0/v0) using the candidate/source Eq18 initial velocity; frozen dimensionless 10-percent initial-depth travel target

rejected_trial.policy: construct an oversized trial that would move z beyond a 100 cm restricted column; reject before commit

hydrologic_relevance_policy: Mass conservation is a hard gate and remains separate from trajectory tolerance.
Front and equivalent-water errors are judged at the finite hydrologic movement scale frozen by the 10-percent travel horizon.
No effort is spent reducing already-qualified Eq18 floating-point association error below hydrologically negligible levels.
hard_guards: No post-result retuning of cases, horizon policy, step counts or thresholds.
No clipping, merge or water repair may be used to pass mass or boundary gates.
No dry-bin creation or rainfall allocation may be inferred from B2D.
No MultiSWAP admission follows from B2D.
